notes:
Trial 2 is identified using the supplied Study 5 / Study 2 identifiers and page locators. The target is the omnibus crossover interaction, not a simple-effect t test or a manipulation check. Original η² is retained as printed; replication partial η² is retained as a printed bound without conversion.
Completion source review (n_r): Study 2-specific participant count is explicitly 120; Procedure states all participants performed both tasks and practice performance was the dependent measure. Abstract independently reports replication N = 120. This is the sample for the critical repeated-measures test; no group sum or df-derived N.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly describe failure to replicate the matching study’s critical outcome; vocabulary failed records their narrative verdict, not an inference from p.
Completion source review (n_o): The explicitly described 34-participant Study 5 sample completed both tasks; those standardized task responses entered the mixed-design ANOVA. Participants are the analytic unit; repeated task scores do not double N. No Study 5 exclusions are reported.
